K-Message Connector — Invoicing

Send invoices on WhatsApp, and let a customer ask what they owe.

This installs itself beside K-Message Connector when you have the matching Odoo app, and does nothing on its own. Set the connection up once, there, and this adds what belongs to this app.

What Odoo says

WhenWhat goes out
An invoice or credit note is postedThe customer gets it with the PDF attached. This rule arrives switched on.
An invoice falls dueA reminder, no more often than its cooldown allows.
A customer paysA thank-you, so the one message people notice is missing is not.

Each rule comes written for you — trigger, template and a field for every placeholder — and each has its own switch.

What a customer may ask

CapabilityAnswers
invoicesWhat that customer owes, their own invoices only.
invoice_pdfThe printed invoice itself, sent as a document.

Each is an individual switch, and each answers only for the customer whose phone number is in the conversation. A credit note is money owed to the customer, so it is never reported as a debt, and "your invoice is due" is never said about one.

Requirements

Odoo 17.0 or 18.0, the K-Message Connector app, and a K-Message account with a WhatsApp number.
